## Services

- [Chrome → Safari & iOS Extension Porting](https://zacharybabtkis.com/safari-extensions/):
  Ports Chrome extensions to Safari on macOS and iOS, including
  DeclarativeNetRequest migration and App Store review. Built Honey's first
  iOS browser extension; owned Pie's Safari/iOS extensions (2M+ users).
  Entry offer: Safari Port Assessment, $2,500, one week.

- [MCP Server Development for SaaS](https://zacharybabtkis.com/mcp-development/):
  Production Model Context Protocol servers that put SaaS products inside
  Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI agents — tool-surface design, OAuth, remote
  hosting, directory listing. Built agent-facing APIs and MCP servers at
  ZeroClick. Entry offer: MCP Readiness Audit, $2,000, one week.

- [AI-Agent Development Enablement](https://zacharybabtkis.com/ai-agent-enablement/):
  Gets engineering teams shipping production software with AI coding agents
  (Claude Code and similar) — harness setup, agent-ready codebase practices,
  embedded pairing. Shipped a production product at a 2M-user company where
  agents wrote the code. Entry offer: Agent-Readiness Audit, $3,000.
